results.question: for each category, how many days on average does it take an item to sell?
results.sql:
SELECT la.category,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d.completed_at - la.listed_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days_to_sell
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON d.item_id = la.item_id
WHERE d.deal_type = 'sale'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
  AND d.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  AND la.listed_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY la.category
ORDER BY la.category;
results.answer: The average time to sell varies by category: bikes_transport takes about 11.20 days, clothing takes 11.32 days, dorm_essentials takes 11.39 days, electronics takes 11.40 days, furniture takes 11.61 days, kitchen takes 11.49 days, other takes 12.08 days, sports_outdoors takes 11.56 days, and textbooks also take 11.56 days. These figures cover all time.

results.question: what share of conversations led to a request, by meetup spot?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot,
       COUNT(*) AS total_conversations,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conversations_led_to_request,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS share_percent
FROM nlq.conversations c
JOIN nlq.listings_all l ON c.item_id = l.item_id
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON l.spot_id = ms.spot_id
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY ms.name;
results.answer: The share of conversations that led to a request varied by meetup spot: Curry Student Center had 61.45% (2,825 out of 4,597), Fenway (off campus) had 62.91% (636 out of 1,011), International Village had 63.00% (2,241 out of 3,557), Marino Recreation Center had 63.61% (1,430 out of 2,248), Mission Hill (off campus) had 62.41% (953 out of 1,527), Snell Library had 62.30% (3,460 out of 5,554), and West Village had 63.55% (1,892 out of 2,977).

results.question: late-return rate for rentals due during finals compared with rentals due during regular classes

  AND c.period IN ('classes', 'finals')

ORDER BY c.period;
